messages:
sam: Heads-up — noticed a weird billing spike tied to SSE resume events over the last hour. Console shows 'cooldown' bucket entries that look duplicated for a subset of tenants.

tasha: Can you paste the console view? which route/model?

sam: Paste: `/v1/streams/resume` on prod-us-west, route shard=shard-17. See two cooldown credits at 12:42 and 12:43 for the same session id.

kevin: That sounds like resume path incrementing both probe and resume-meter. We recently added a cooldown meter on the proxy side and kept the existing resume charge in the router. Might be double-charge.

linda: @kevin are those two meters tagged differently? console should group by tag, but UI grouping is flaky for low-cardinality tags.

kevin: Probe meter tagged `probe.cooldown` and router meter `resume.attempt`. They both map to cost buckets but with different telemetry keys.

sam: opsbot shows these events in the eventlog too: ```[12:42:08] resume: session=abc123 attempts=1 route=shard-17 proxy=probe.cooldown=true``` ```[12:42:08] router: charge resume.attempt tenant=acme session=abc123```

opsbot: Incident note created: INC-2026-482 — suspected duplicate metering on resume. Assigned to @kevin.

alex: Quick thought — is this only when resume falls back to sticky routing? we recently toggled sticky fallback for canary tenants.

sam: Good call. The duplicates are almost all from tenants in the sticky-canary cohort.

kevin: Ok repro path: client disconnect -> resume request hits edge -> proxy emits probe cooldown (to avoid thundering) -> router also treats the resume as a billable attempt on route swap. For sticky fallback we do both. We should make router idempotent by checking probe tag or dedupe on session id.

tasha: Would dedupe in router break any billing for legitimate separate attempts? e.g., network flapping where probe false-negative then real resume?

kevin: We can dedupe within a short window (200ms) keyed by session id + request id. That preserves distinct attempts but drops duplicate emissions from the proxy instrumentation.

linda: Console UX ask — for now can we show both metrics merged under a single "resume" line and annotate when both meters fired? That would prevent noise spikes in the dashboard.

sam: Agreed — ops wants merged view + an explanatory tooltip: "Duplicate meters may indicate proxy+router overlap; contact eng-platform."

kevin: Quick fix plan: (1) Add router-side dedupe by session within 250ms. (2) Tag probe.cooldown with `origin=proxy` so we can filter. (3) Console: merge by logical operation `resume` for the visual layer. I'll open a tiny PR for (1) and (2).

alex: Can someone add a regression test to the resume e2e harness that simulates sticky fallback so we don't reintroduce it?

kevin: Yep, adding test case.

linda: I'll file a console ticket for merged view + tooltip — assigning to @ui-team and linking INC-2026-482.

sam: Thx. For follow-up, let's capture a short playbook step: if spike > x% in 5m and majority of events have tag `probe.cooldown`, mute the extra alert and page on duplicates.

opsbot: INC-2026-482 status: triaged -> in_progress.

kevin: PR 8142 opened: router dedupe + tag change. Will monitor telemetry after deploy.

sam: Rolling canary now, keeping an eye on console. so far metrics look less noisy for shard-17.

tasha: nice! will check cost dashboard and confirm reduction before we ramp to 100%.

linda: UI ticket 3987 created with mock for merged resume line.

kevin: Leaving a note: long-term we should unify metering contract between proxy and router to avoid overlapping responsibilities.

sam: Agreed. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
